info.description:
REST API for Vani, Zoho's collaborative whiteboard. Manage editions, teams, spaces and zones; create and edit the objects on a zone canvas; and build whole structures — mindmaps, flowcharts, kanban boards and tables — in a single call.

This document contains every Vani API operation. The per-resource documents beside it (editions, teams, spaces, zones, canvas, and the rest) are subsets of this one. Generate a client from this file OR from the per-resource files, not both: they describe the same operations, so generating from both produces duplicate types.
